entries.title: Psalms 99:1
segments: Jehovah reigneth; let the peoples tremble: He  sitteth [above] the cherubim; let the earth be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 99:2
segments: Jehovah is great in Zion; And he is high above all the peoples.

entries.title: Psalms 99:3
segments: Let them praise thy great and terrible name: Holy is he.

entries.title: Psalms 99:4
segments: The king's strength also loveth justice; Thou dost establish equity; Thou executest justice and righteousness in Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 99:5
segments: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his footstool: Holy is he.

entries.title: Psalms 99:6
segments: Moses and Aaron among his priests, And Samuel among them that call upon his name; They called upon Jehovah, and he answered them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:7
segments: He spake unto them in the pillar of cloud: They kept his testimonies, And the statute that he gave them.

entries.title: Psalms 99:8
segments: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.

entries.title: Psalms 99:9
segments: Exalt ye Jehovah our God, And worship at his holy hill; For Jehovah our God is holy.
